column1: # Base-red skip list for scripts/ci/cmux-tui-rust-check.sh (modes test and all).
# One test per line, tab-separated: FILTER BEAD EXPIRES OS REASON
#   FILTER   libtest --skip substring; use the full test path or a unique test name
#   BEAD     the bead that owns the fix (required)
#   EXPIRES  YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, the review date; after it the skip still applies and each run warns
#   OS       any, macos or linux: where the skip applies
# Remove the line in the same push as the fix. Never extend an expiry without the bead owner.
